titleEn: Royal Decree No. 0421/345 on launching of Kep Provincial Court

articles.en:
- The Kep Provincial Court is hereby brought into operation from 24 September 2021 onwards.
The Kep Provincial Court shall have one prosecutor's office, in accordance with the provisions of the Law on Court Organisation and other applicable laws.
[Illegible in source]

.
The Kep Provincial Court shall be located in Kep Province and shall have jurisdiction to adjudicate cases falling within the territorial jurisdiction covering Kep Province, in accordance with the laws and regulations in force.

- The Kep Provincial Court shall have jurisdiction to adjudicate cases falling within its competence from 24 September 2021 onwards.
As regards any case files falling within the competence of the Kep Provincial Court which the Kampot Provincial Court has already received in its capacity as competent court before 24 September 2021, the Kampot Provincial Court shall continue to handle them as the competent court in accordance with the laws and regulations in force.
The rules set out in paragraphs 1 and 2 above shall likewise apply to the Prosecutor's Office attached to the Kampot Provincial Court.

- In the event that the Kep Provincial Court is unable to operate, jurisdiction to adjudicate cases falling within the competence of the Kep Provincial Court shall fall to the Kampot Provincial Court.
In such case, the Minister of Justice shall issue a prakas to determine the inability of the Kep Provincial Court to operate and to re-determine the date on which that court commences operation.
If the Kep Provincial Court has an insufficient number of judges or is short of judges owing to incompatibility or other reasons, the President of the Kep Provincial Court shall request the Minister of Justice to assign judges from other provincial courts to perform the work as necessary.

.
Any provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

.
The Supreme Council of the Magistracy and Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards; Royal seal; Norodom Sihamoni; at the Royal Palace, 03 April 2021.
